item.text: I found the regressions in four places: bests are overwritten unconditionally and displayed as zero when absent; the board has roving tab stops but no arrow-key handler; reduced-motion rules are missing; and the game calls the Web Audio API after matches. I’m checking the repo’s documented constraints before editing.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type { RefObject } from 'react';

interface ScrollPosition {
  readonly left: number;
  readonly top: number;
}

// Chromium centers a card that Tab or Shift+Tab focuses inside the board before focus handlers
// run. Scroll events arrive a frame later, so the last board position they reported still shows
// the view from before that scroll. Restoring it first lets the card scroll from where the player
// was looking, with nearest alignment in the board. The page scroll is left to the browser.
export function useNearestScroll(viewport: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>) {
  const board = useRef<ScrollPosition>({ left: 0, top: 0 });
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = viewport.current;
    function boardScrolled(): void {
      if (element) board.current = { left: element.scrollLeft, top: element.scrollTop };
    }
    boardScrolled();
    element?.addEventListener('scroll', boardScrolled, { passive: true });
    return () => element?.removeEventListener('scroll', boardScrolled);
  }, [viewport]);

  return useCallback(
    (card: HTMLElement): void => {
      viewport.current?.scrollTo(board.current.left, board.current.top);
      card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
    },
    [viewport],
  );
}

item.text:
Fixed all four issues:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts) now keeps the lower best score. [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx) shows “none” for a size with no completed best.
- [Card.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Card.tsx) restores arrow-key navigation between cards, with movement clamped at board edges.
- [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css) and [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css) disable card transitions and the win animation when reduced motion is enabled.
- [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts) no longer plays match or win sounds.

`git diff --check` is clean. I did not run tests or other project checks.
